title: The compatible map on completions of prime localizations
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings with an R-algebra structure on S, and q a prime of S. Put p = q ∩ R, Rp = R_p and Sq = S_q [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], Ip and Iq their maximal ideals, and Rph and Sqh their corresponding adic completions [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let f : Rp → Sq be the induced local homomorphism. There exists a ring map ψ : Rph → Sqh such that for every n ≥ 0, x ∈ Rph and a ∈ Rp, if the nth coordinate of x is the class of a modulo Ip^n, then the nth coordinate of ψ(x) is the class of f(a) modulo Iq^n. No Noetherian, finite-type or quasi-finite assumption is required.

proof.text: The induced localization map is local, so it maps the maximal ideal, and each of its powers, into the target maximal ideal and its powers (IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_le and Ideal.map_pow).

Construct the maps on ideal-power quotients with Ideal.quotientMap. Their composites with the source evaluations commute with reduction: use AdicCompletion.induction_on and Ideal.mk_eq_mk. Apply AdicCompletion.liftRingHom and evalₐ_liftRingHom.

theorem exists_completion_map_atPrime
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S) :
    let p : Ideal R := q.comap (algebraMap R S)
    let Rp := Localization.AtPrime p
    let Sq := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
    let Ip := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Rp
    let Iq := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Sq
    let Rph := AdicCompletion Ip Rp
    let Sqh := AdicCompletion Iq Sq
    let f : Rp →+* Sq := Localization.localRingHom p q.asIdeal (algebraMap R S) rfl
    ∃ ψ : Rph →+* Sqh,
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Rph) (a : Rp),
        AdicCompletion.evalₐ Ip n x = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ip ^ n) a →
        AdicCompletion.evalₐ Iq n (ψ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Iq ^ n) (f a)
